question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Keep someone at arm’s length

options.text: To avoid becoming too close or friendly with someone
Having energy again after being tired

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Keep someone at arm's length"** means to avoid becoming too close or friendly with someone. (किसी से बहुत करीब या दोस्ताना नहीं होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tends to keep her colleagues at arm's length to maintain professionalism.
 
 
 
• **"To avoid becoming too close or friendly with someone" **refers to maintaining a certain distance in relationships to avoid intimacy. (किसी के साथ बहुत करीब या दोस्ताना होने से बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **He keeps his neighbors at arm's length to preserve his privacy.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** "To avoid becoming too close or friendly with someone."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To ruin someone’s plans **(किसी की योजनाओं को बर्बाद करना): To interfere with someone's plans and cause them to fail.

 
 
• **Example:** The unexpected rain** ruined our plans for a picnic.**
 
 
 
• **Angry about something **(किसी बात पर गुस्सा होना): Feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure.
 
 
• **Example: **He was **angry about the unfair treatment he received.**
 
 
 
• **Having energy again after being tired** (थकान के बाद फिर से ऊर्जा प्राप्त करना): Feeling rejuvenated and energetic after a period of fatigue.
 
 
• **Example:** After a good night's sleep, she felt fresh and** energetic again.**
 
 

1fa:Tbab,
The correct answer is **Option 1)**
